NVIDIA Dynamo is a high-throughput, low-latency inference framework for serving generative AI and reasoning models across multi-node distributed environments. Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility, Dynamo orchestrates GPU shards, routes requests, and manages shared KV cache across heterogeneous clusters so that many accelerators feel like a single system at datacenter scale. We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to define the vision and roadmap for memory management of large-scale LLM and storage systems.

Engineers on the Polaris team design tasks that test Gemini’s ability to complete software engineering work. A task is essentially an in-depth examination that evaluates how well Gemini performs in a specific, complex scenario. The primary components of a task are: a prompt that instructs Gemini what to do and a grader or rubric that assigns a numerical score to the model’s attempted solution.

Our team, Polaris, is distinguished primarily by how much manual effort we put into building individual tasks. Rather than generating a large number of tasks using a synthetic data pipeline, engineers on the Polaris team prioritize creating a smaller number of tasks that more closely capture the realism and complexity of real-world software engineering. A single well-designed task typically takes a Polaris engineer roughly one week to complete, from the initial ideation stage to final approval.

The Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Safety and Alignment Team (ASAT) aims to reduce existential and catastrophic risk from AGI and eventually Artificial Superintelligence (ASI). We research novel techniques and work with the rest of GDM and Google to apply them. We advise executive leadership on safety.

ASAT has sub-teams specializing in making future Geminis more thoroughly aligned by finding and fixing sources of misalignment and exploring alignment techniques with better generalization. Preparing for future AGI risks by simulating them today and using interpretability techniques to understand AI and solve practical problems like model forensics or evaluation (eval) awareness. Building control for GDM’s agents as defense-in-depth against potential misaligned internal deployments. Researching training techniques, like debate, for aligning superhuman AI and ways to retain, improve, and measure monitorability. Researching and implementing ways to assess the ways in which a given model might be imperfectly aligned and developing and implementing tools and AI assistance that accelerates safety research. Advising executive leadership on risks posed by AI systems via the frontier safety framework based on our threat models and evaluations.

Engineers on the Polaris team design tasks that test Gemini’s ability to complete software engineering work. A task is essentially an in-depth examination that evaluates how well Gemini performs in a specific, complex scenario. The primary components of a task are: a prompt that instructs Gemini what to do and a grader or rubric that assigns a numerical score to the model’s attempted solution.

Our team, Polaris, is distinguished primarily by how much manual effort we put into building individual eval tasks. Rather than generating a large number of tasks using a synthetic data pipeline, engineers on the Polaris team prioritize creating a smaller number of tasks that more closely capture the realism and complexity of real-world software engineering. A single well-designed task typically takes a Polaris engineer roughly one week to complete, from the initial ideation stage to final approval.

There are no education or degree requirements for this role.

この職種では、日本とアジア太平洋地域のエグゼクティブ マーケティング マネージャーやチームメンバーと直接連携して業務を進める機会が得られます。流動的な環境で、活気あふれるチームと協力しながら、クリエイターのロイヤリティを維持すべく、印象的な瞬間を創出する経験を積むことができます。楽しくポジティブなイメージの醸成、クリエイター エコシステムの強化、イベントの最適化などが職務範囲に含まれます。

Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.

Global online platforms like YouTube face a complex balancing act in the digital age: protecting copyright while safeguarding freedom of expression—a challenge further amplified by the rise of Generative AI.

As a Copyright Operations Specialist, you will partner with cross-functional technical and legal teams to address the most dynamic challenges in digital policy and intellectual property. You will design and implement operational strategies for emerging areas such as GenAI, scale complex workflows, and navigate novel legal questions at the forefront of copyright law.

In this role, you will manage high-stakes, ambiguous copyright disputes at the intersection of law, technology, and creativity—ensuring fair, nuanced policy enforcement during critical global moments. Beyond resolving sensitive escalations, you will leverage dispute data and frontline insights to shape YouTube’s long-term rights management strategy, driving systemic process innovations across Trust & Safety. You will also play a pivotal leadership role guiding our rapidly expanding global vendor workforce.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $301000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

  • Author research papers to share and generate impact of research results across organization and in the research community.

  • 2 years of experience in coding and leading multiple research efforts and influencing research direction.

Một vấn đề không được coi là đã giải quyết triệt để cho đến khi nó được giải quyết cho tất cả mọi người. Đó là lý do tại sao các nhân viên Google (Googlers) luôn xây dựng các sản phẩm giúp tạo ra cơ hội cho mọi người, dù là ngay trong khu phố hay trên toàn thế giới. Với tư cách là Quản lý Chương trình (Program Manager) tại Google, bạn sẽ dẫn dắt các dự án phức tạp, đa chuyên ngành từ khi bắt đầu đến khi kết thúc — làm việc với các bên liên quan để lập kế hoạch yêu cầu, quản lý tiến độ dự án, xác định rủi ro và giao tiếp rõ ràng với các đối tác liên chức năng trong toàn công ty. Các dự án của bạn thường trải dài qua nhiều văn phòng, múi giờ và các bán cầu khác nhau. Nhiệm vụ của bạn là điều phối các thành viên và cập nhật cho họ về tiến độ cũng như thời hạn công việc.

Với vai trò là Quản lý Chương trình Vận hành (Operations Program Manager), bạn sẽ là đầu mối liên lạc chính về sản xuất (primary manufacturing interface) cho các sản phẩm phần cứng. Bạn sẽ làm việc với đội ngũ kỹ thuật và sản phẩm của Google để thúc đẩy các giai đoạn xây dựng phát triển sản phẩm và hỗ trợ những thay đổi đang diễn ra đối với các sản phẩm hiện có. Bạn cũng sẽ dẫn dắt một đội ngũ để đảm bảo các sản phẩm được thiết kế và chế tạo theo đúng các tiêu chuẩn về tính năng và chất lượng. Đội ngũ Giới thiệu Sản phẩm Mới (NPI) cũng xác định chiến lược nguồn cung (sourcing strategy) cho các sản phẩm.

游戏出海团队致力于成为大中华区手游开发者与发行商全球化进程中的坚实伙伴。我们深度整合 Google 广告生态矩阵，通过定制化的用户获取策略与商业化变现路径，持续赋能优质游戏在国际市场实现突破，助力客户打造具有全球影响力的顶级爆款。Google Ads 致力于通过卓越的技术为开放的网络提供助力，促进用户、发布商、广告客户和 Google 的互利共赢。我们由多个团队组成，负责打造 Google 的广告产品和分析工具，广告产品包括搜索广告、展示广告、购物广告、旅游广告和视频广告。这些团队帮助商家投放对用户有实用价值的广告，促进用户与商家之间建立信任关系。我们面向广告客户提供富有成效且效果可量化的工具，助力小型公司、大型品牌、YouTube 创作者等各种规模的商家实现业务发展。我们还致力于帮助 Google 实现与客户的规模化互动。

ích về mọi mặt cho người dùng. Chúng tôi nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ cùng phần cứng mới để người dùng có thể tương tác với công nghệ điện toán một cách nhanh chóng, mạnh mẽ và liền mạch hơn. Nhóm Thiết bị và dịch vụ đang làm cho cuộc sống của mọi người

Responsibilities

    động.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, validate, optimize standards and engineering CMOS Backplane test solutions for microLED display panels, including CMOS control software solutions. Ensure software test platform and architecture meet the needs of fast moving production and R&D environments.
  • Interface with wafer-level probe cards, test equipment, and instrumentation to facilitate Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS)/Silicon testing and characterization.
  • Identify, diagnose, resolve electrical issues during wafer-level testing using digital oscilloscopes and other testing equipment.
  • Collaborate with CMOS and panel test engineering teams to define and implement high-speed, automated testing solutions for IC/Silicon/CMOS and microLED displays, and debug process plans for manufacturing. Optimize these solutions to ensure test coverage and minimize the test cost.
  • Work with the Test Engineering team to enhance and develop test frameworks based on requirements from the Reliability Team.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3 years of experience with Silicon test hardware, software debugging, and data analysis in a Research and Development (R&D) or manufacturing environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP).
  • Experience with testing software development, Python, and SQL databases, and familiarity with Linux and Ubuntu.
  • Familiarity with test instruments such as power supply, current meter, voltage meter, digital meter, spectrometer, and other electrical lab equipment.
  • Familiarity with firmware concepts, low-level register programming (bare metal programming in C/C++ for microcontrollers), I2C and SPI, and SRAM memory test patterns.
  • Knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals (CMOS and register-level understanding), power management, display architecture, and video standards (e.g., HDMI or MIPI).

Google では、ユーザーを第一に考えています。常に変化し続ける世界の中でプロダクト マネージャーに求められるのは、変化に敏感に対応し、億単位のユーザーが日常的に触れるプロダクトの開発にわくわくしながら取り組めることです。

プロダクト マネージャーは、さまざまなチームと協力し、技術の世界とビジネスの世界を行き来しながら、プロダクトの構想からリリースまでを主導するポジションです。複雑な問題を具体的な処理手順に落とし込み、プロダクト開発を進められる人材が求められます。

Google が、世界を変える革新的なプロダクトをコンスタントに提供できる理由の一つは、プロダクト マネジメントにおける共同作業です。プロダクト マネジメント チームはクリエイティブなエンジニア、デザイナー、マーケティング担当者などと密に協力して、世界中の情報アクセスを改善するためのテクノロジーの設計と開発を支援しています。このチームの使命は、Google ソリューションの分析、ポジショニング、パッケージング、プロモーション、カスタマイズに重点を置きながら、プロダクトの実行サイクル全体を主導することです。

Google マップと Google 検索ならではの大きな差別化要因として挙げられるのが、ユーザーによるレビューやマップに加えられた編集などのユーザー作成コンテンツ（UGC）です。ユーザーが行き先を決めるうえで重要なだけでなく、マップを最新の状態に保つうえでも大きな役割を果たしています。

リアルワールド エクスペリエンス チーム（RWE）は、世界中のユーザーがユーザー作成コンテンツを通じて現実世界での体験を共有し、その豊富な情報を自身の意思決定に活用できるようにするという目標の実現に取り組んでいます。日々投稿され続けるレビュー、評価、写真、動画、質問への答えは、Google 検索と Google マップのユーザーが行き先を決めるうえで役立っており、さらに、世界中で Google 検索およびマップのビジネスの発展と改善にも寄与しています。

RWE クリエイティブ編集チームの使命は、ユーザーが Google マップに役立つ信頼できるメディア（写真や動画など）を簡単に投稿できるようにすることです。これにより、他のユーザーはどこに行くかについて十分な情報に基づいて意思決定できるようになります。ジオチームは、マップ、Earth、ストリートビュー、Google Maps Platform などのプロダクトを通じて、Google ユーザーの皆様に正確かつ包括的で、利便性が高い地図を提供するために取り組んでいます。世界を広げ、日常生活に役立つ Google マップのサービスは、月間 10 億人を超えるユーザーによって日々利用されています。

また、さまざまなアプリやウェブサイトの強化に Google Maps Platform の機能を活用できるよう、デベロッパーの皆様を支援するのもジオチームの役割です。このチームは、複雑なコンピュータ サイエンスの問題解決、直感的に操作できる美しいプロダクト デザイン、実世界の把握精度の向上を通じて、地図の未来を切り拓きます。

Responsibilities

  • クリエイティブ編集（メディアなど）の長期的な目標とプロダクト戦略に責任を持ち、UGC メディアの成長促進に重点を置いた、優先順位付けされた具体的なロードマップに落とし込む。
  • 進化する AI の状況に適応しながら、信頼できる高品質なユーザー作成コンテンツ（UGC）エクスペリエンスを構築する。
  • UX、リサーチ、エンジニアリングの各チームと協力して、ユーザー作成コンテンツの投稿と利用の両方に対応する新しい機能を設計、リリース、導入する。
  • データ、エンジニアリング、UX、リサーチ、ポリシー / 法務などのクロスファンクショナルなパートナー チームと緊密に連携し、整合性を図る。
  • 組織全体で合意を形成し、主要なステークホルダーからの支持を取り付けて、ロードマップのイニシアチブを推進する。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • 学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • プロダクト マネジメントに携わった 5 年以上の経験。
  • 技術的なプロダクトの構想からリリースまで携わった 2 年以上の経験（アイディエーションから実行まで、エンドツーエンド、0 から 1 の立ち上げなど）。

Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to our customers and serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use the expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans while using the business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions. You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of GCP portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting business goals.
  • Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
  • Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers, continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
  • Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
  • Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

  • 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
  • Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling technical solutions in data analytics or cloud AI.
  • Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
  • Experience building technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
  • Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
  • Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).

You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Build and improve the next generation of ML Infrastructure at Google. Our team is part of the Core ML organization which is the central machine learning organization that provides ML software tools and hardware infrastructure to all the Google product areas and is driving ML excellence for Google and the world. From ML frameworks to performance debugging and tooling, from ML efficiency to applied ML, our team is involved in various aspects of AI and infrastructure that is pushing the ML frontier across all of Google.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry.   • Experience with accelerator HW architectures (TPUs/GPUs).
  • Experience with ML Inference frameworks such as vLLM, SG Lang, Pathways.
  • Experience with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, JAX, PyTorch, Keras.

You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of client Marketing and Business Objectives. Design optimal measurement strategies and define sophisticated Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) tailored to client maturity.
  • Lead the end-to-end execution of measurement studies—including Conversion Lift, Brand Lift, XNR, and Geo-based Experiment —ensuing statistical significance (StatSig) on all uplift data.
  • Utilize advanced investigative skills to model experimental results and triage them into broader media plan Return on Investment (ROI) analyses. Analyze attribute lift across channels to inform high-level channel strategy and budget allocation.
  • Reconcile disparate data sources (MMM, MTA, and Incrementality) to provide a unified narrative of media effectiveness, helping clients navigate the shift toward third-party measurement.
  • Partner with In-Market Sales and Product Specialist teams to interpret complex measurement results for client leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with marketing analytics, return on investment, and statistical analysis.
  • Experience in designing and executing incrementality studies and A/B testing frameworks.
  • Experience in managing external and internal stakeholder relationships and owning a portfolio of customers.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Expertise in SQL, Python, or R for building data models and pulling insights from large, complex datasets.
  • Experience defining measurement frameworks for mid-funnel and audience acquisition goals, moving beyond traditional last-click conversion tracking.
  • Specialized experience in Media Mix Modeling (MMM), Incremenality and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) tools , with the ability to validate and integrate results from multiple measurement "sources of truth.
  • Deep understanding of the technical trends around privacy-safe measurement, conversion analytics, and attribution best practices.

Google’s advertising measurement team focuses on combining data at scale with formal science to make this possible. Our science helps make advertising useful and delightful to our users, and valuable and results-driven for our advertisers and publishers.

As a part of this team, data scientists bring scientific statistical methods to bear on the challenges of advertising product creation, development and improvement with a deep, data-driven appreciation for the behaviors of the end user and the ecosystem. As a Data Scientist working on Ads Insights and Measurement, you will develop, evaluate and improve the entire range of Google's advertising products including Search, Display, Apps, TV and Video (YouTube). You will collaborate closely with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, analysts and product managers to develop new science and to translate it into deployed products at scale. You will also play a key role in developing new ideas and methods that drive ad measurement and monetization, including paradigm-shifting ad-measurement science and products for the privacy-preserving future of digital advertising. You will be a key part of building and driving impact on large-scale ad-systems both at Google and in the ad-tech and mar-tech industry as a whole, globally.

In this role, individuals with an interest in understanding consumer behavior, advertising and privacy, a passion for business problems, and an interest in combining data and strategy will grow in the environment. You will be able to leverage their training and skills to leverage data and technology to make business decisions.

Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a Chip Package Designer on the Silicon Integration team, your role is to develop package substrate designs of advanced (2.5D/3.5D) packaging technologies for ML chips. This involves collaborating with SI/PI, Thermal/Mechanical, Assembly, and PCB engineers to create complex, high-performance substrate designs, where your goal is to optimize package substrate design for electrical performance, reliability, and assembly.

You will manage all phases of the design process, including routing feasibility, test vehicle creation, product designs, conducting design reviews, artwork export, DFM process and generating final documentation. Additionally, you will be instrumental in identifying and incorporating advanced chip packaging technologies into the Google chip product design pipeline, which contributes to successful chip deployment in data centers, ensuring the best optimized PPA (Power, Performance, Area) designs and enhancing system performance relative to TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and power.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

Beyond the VMM, we are deepening our focus on hardware-level isolation and I/O performance. This includes sophisticated IOMMU (Input-Output Memory Management Unit) integration to secure DMA and interrupt remapping, ensuring hardware devices remain strictly confined to guest-specific memory regions. We are building a virtualization stack that maximizes density and security without compromising on near-native execution speeds.

You'll set up methodologies, perform simulations, silicon characterization and correlations to ensure our IC designs meet systems design budgets and achieve the highest performance. You will work with systems architects, ASIC design, systems engineers, and partner cross-functionally with teams and external vendors/partners.

Responsibilities

  • Design and optimize power distribution networks (PDN) across chip, package, and board levels. This includes managing power/ground planes, decoupling capacitors, and power gating strategies.
  • Conduct both pre-layout and post-layout power integrity simulations to analyze power and ground noise (SSN/SSO), voltage drops (IR drop), and electromagnetic interference (EMI).
  • Implement and verify low-power design methodologies, such as multi-voltage designs and clock gating, using power intent formats like UPF/CPF.
  • Generate precise electrical models (e.g., S-parameters, SPICE models) for components such as packages, PCBs, and connectors for use in simulations.
  • Execute lab measurements utilizing test equipment like oscilloscopes, Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), Spectrum analyzers to validate simulation outcomes and debug signal and power-related issues on silicon prototypes and boards.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Material Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in signal or power integrity or hardware design.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with industry-standard Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools for simulation and layout (e.g., Cadence Sigrity/Allegro, Ansys HFSS/PowerDC/Q3D, Keysight ADS, Synopsys HSPICE).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl for flow automation and data analysis.
  • Familiarity with high-speed testing equipment like VNAs, TDRs, and oscilloscopes for measurement and validation.
  • Knowledge of circuit analysis, electromagnetics, and transmission line theory.

Quản lý quy trình báo cáo vấn đề lên cấp trên về chất lượng tại nhà máy, giải quyết các vấn đề liên quan đến chất lượng sản phẩm được phát hiện trong giai đoạn ra mắt sản phẩm mới (NPI) và sản xuất hàng loạt (MP). Quản lý quy trình phân tích lỗi tại nhà máy, đánh giá rủi ro, xử lý và triển khai các biện pháp cô lập/khắc phục/phòng ngừa.

Thiết lập các chỉ số chất lượng phù hợp. Thúc đẩy tiến trình thiết kế thử nghiệm (DOE) và thu thập dữ liệu kiểm soát quy trình thống kê (SPC) để đánh giá, kiểm định và xác minh chất lượng sản xuất của tất cả các nhà sản xuất và dòng sản phẩm theo thoả thuận.
Dẫn dắt quy trình quản lý thẩm mỹ cho sản phẩm và quản lý chất lượng vật liệu trong giai đoạn Lắp ráp hoàn thiện, kiểm thử và đóng gói (FATP).
fit: Bằng cử nhân ngành Kỹ thuật điện, Kỹ thuật công nghiệp/sản xuất hoặc Kỹ thuật cơ khí hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.

2 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực phát triển chất lượng sản phẩm.
Bằng thạc sĩ ngành Kỹ thuật hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
5 năm kinh nghiệm giám sát hoạt động cải thiện năng suất và rút ngắn thời gian hoàn thành chu trình sản xuất.

Kinh nghiệm ngăn chặn vấn đề suy giảm chất lượng ngay từ giai đoạn đầu trong quá trình phát triển sản phẩm, triển khai quy trình báo cáo vấn đề chất lượng lên cấp trên và liên tục cải tiến sản phẩm cùng các đối tác JDM.

Kinh nghiệm áp dụng các chỉ số chất lượng, nắm bắt quy trình phân tích hệ thống đo lường tối quan trọng của JMP, nâng cao phạm vi chất lượng đầu ra và triển khai các phương pháp hiệu quả, tiết kiệm chi phí.
Kinh nghiệm làm việc với các hệ thống nhúng, xây dựng quy trình tạo bảng mạch logic kỹ thuật số và thử nghiệm hệ thống con không dây.

本職種は、セキュリティ コンサルタントとして、お客様がサイバー セキュリティの脅威に効果的に備え、そういった脅威を事前に軽減しつつ、その検出と対応を行えるようサポートするポジションです。コンピュータ サイエンス、オペレーティング システムの機能とネットワーキング、クラウド サービス、企業ネットワーク環境に関する知識 を併せ持ち、その知識をサイバー セキュリティの脅威への対応に活用する方法に精通していることが求められます。

セキュリティ コンサルタントとして、お客様が技術的に複雑で重要なインシデントに対処し、フォレンジック分析、脅威ハンティング、マルウェアのトリアージを実行できるよう支援するなどのエンゲージメントを担当していただきます。最新の手法のエミュレーションによってお客様のネットワーク、アプリケーション、デバイスをテストし、お客様の脅威に対する防御をサポートするとともに、情報セキュリティ要件の重要性を伝え、情報セキュリティ分野についての深い洞察を提供することも職務の一環です。また、ビジネス関係者、経営陣、技術担当者に向けて複雑な概念を提示して明確に説明し、部門横断型チームと協力して複雑なエンゲージメントを適切に主導することも求められます。

Mandiant コンサルティングは、クライアント組織の取締役会、経営幹部、ビジネス リーダー、テクノロジー リーダーに対し、カスタマイズされたコンサルティングの専門知識を提供し、お客様の長期的な成功を確実にすることを目指しています。Mandiant コンサルティングは、インシデント対応とその備え、脅威インテリジェンス、攻撃的セキュリティ テスト、サイバー防御のモニタリングと対応、セキュリティ機能の改善など、さまざまな分野の能力を強化することで、お客様のサイバー防御の評価、設計、テスト、管理を支援します。長年にわたり、Mandiant は高度なサイバー攻撃の被害者を支援する頼れるパートナーとして、そのブランドと評判を築いてきました。この分野の世界的リーダーとして認められている当社では、すべてのコンサルタントがお客様から即座に信頼と尊敬を得ています。経営陣への助言やサイバー クライシスへの対応支援、お客様とともにあたる規制当局との折衝など、多岐にわたる役割を求められています。

Google Cloud の子会社である Mandiant は、動的なサイバー防衛、脅威インテリジェンス、インシデント対応サービスのリーダーとして認められ、そのサイバーセキュリティに関する専門知識は、世界中のセキュリティに関する専門家や企業の経営幹部から高い信頼を得ています。複雑なセキュリティ侵害に最前線で対応してきた経験、国家レベルの脅威インテリジェンス、マシン インテリジェンス、業界最高水準のセキュリティ検証能力を唯一無二の形でかけ合わせています。これにより Mandiant は高度な脅威に関する知識において他社の追随を許しません。

Responsibilities

  • エンゲージメントの実施期間中は、お客様との関係を主導し、すべてのコンサルティング エンゲージメント（すべてのサイバーセキュリティ エンゲージメントにおける質の高いデリバリー、プロジェクトの収益性、カスタマー エクスペリエンスなど）の成果に責任を持つ。
  • セキュリティの動向、業界に関連するリスク、調査から得られた教訓について、テクノロジー リーダーやエグゼクティブを対象としたセッションを実施する。
  • お客様のニーズや懸念を理解して見極め、コンサルティング サービスで支援する機会を特定する。地域のセールス リーダーシップ、セールス スペシャリスト、セールス担当者、チャネル パートナー エコシステムを通じて、Mandiant コンサルティング ビジネスの持続可能なオポチュニティ パイプラインを構築し、管理する。
  • 経営幹部、ビジネス リーダー、テクノロジー リーダー、セキュリティ リーダーと連携して、サイバー セキュリティに対する信頼度を評価し、Mandiant の最前線の経験とソート リーダーシップを共有することで、お客様の認識に働きかけ、形成を促す。
  • セールスチームが強力で持続可能なオポチュニティ パイプラインを構築できるようサポートし、サイバーセキュリティ サポートに関する問い合わせに対応する。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • 工学分野の学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • 認定情報システム セキュリティ プロフェッショナル（CISSP）や公認情報セキュリティ マネージャー（CISM）などの認定資格。
  • サイバーセキュリティ コンサルティング サービスの提供に携わった 8 年以上の経験。
  • 経営幹部、ビジネス開発、市場拡大、お客様との関係管理に携わった 7 年以上の経験。
  • 日本語と英語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、社内外の関係者とスムーズに連絡を取り合えること。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • セキュリティとリスクのコンセプトを、経営幹部を含むあらゆる対象者に明確化した経験。
  • ローカル ビジネス リーダーや外部担当者と連携してコンサルティング ビジネスの創出を推進した経験。
  • エンゲージメントのイネーブルメント（対象範囲の決定、カスタマイズされたエンゲージメントの構築、提案書の作成、作業明細書の作成など）を行った経験。
  • 経営幹部や役員レベルのお客様と期待値を調整し、信頼関係を構築できる能力。

Google Cloud は、あらゆる組織のビジネスと業界におけるデジタル トランスフォーメーションを加速させるとともに、Google のテクノロジーを活用したエンタープライズ クラスのソリューションと、デベロッパーがよりサステナブルに構築に取り組めるようにするツールを提供します。200 以上の国や地域のお客様が、成長を可能にし、最も重大なビジネス上の問題を解決するための信頼できるパートナーとして、Google Cloud を採用しています。

Responsibilities

  • お客様のビジネスとテクノロジーの課題に対するソリューションを提供し、セールスと連携して新たな機会を特定して成約に結びつけ、革新的なソリューションを提案することで、お客様のデジタル変革を支援する。また、可視性、使用統計情報、KPI を通じてお客様がクラウドの使用状況を把握できるようにし、推奨事項を検証して成功を追跡する。
  • イノベーションに関する専門知識を活用して、複雑な問題を解決し、包括的なプログラムを作成する。ワークショップを主導して、新しいアイデアを特定し、優先順位を付ける。
  • プロダクト プラン、カスタマー ジャーニー、市場開拓戦略の策定と実施を主導し、明確な重要業績評価指標（KPI）を通じて成功を確実なものにする。
  • 社内外のコラボレーションを促進して関係各所との整合性を保ち、ドキュメントを適切に管理するとともに、進捗状況を効果的に伝達する。
  • ユーザー調査とペルソナベースのインタビューを実施して、明確にされていないニーズを明らかにし、ビジネス変革の体系的な機会を特定する。デザイン シンキング ツールを活用して、影響力の大きいワークショップを促進し、お客様が複雑な課題を再構築して変革的なアイデアに優先順位を付けるのを支援する。

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with mixed-signal verification tools (e.g., verilog-AMS, Real Number Modeling (RNM), or SystemVerilog-AMS).

  • Experience with performance verification (throughput, latency, and power modeling).
  • Experience in formal verification (JasperGold or similar) for complex state machines.
  • Understanding of adaptive algorithms (FFE/DFE) and how to verify loop stability in a digital environment.

The Business Undergrad Internship Program is a paid summer internship for undergraduate college students that are interested in working in non-technical career opportunities at Google.

Interns are placed on teams across the company in fields of work within Sales, Marketing and Finance. Google Cloud Platform チームの使命は、クラウドに組み込まれたテクノロジーを活用して、お客様のビジネスの変革と進化に貢献することです。Google のプロダクトは、インフラストラクチャからアプリケーション、デバイス、ハードウェアまで多岐にわたりますが、いずれもセキュリティ、信頼性、拡張性を重視して開発されています。このチームでは、さまざまな企業、教育機関、政府機関、デベロッパーなどの皆様に、Google のテクノロジーがもたらすメリットを活用していただけるよう取り組んでいます。急成長するこの業界で、起業家精神あふれるチームの一員としてお客様のニーズを把握する重要な役割を果たし、あらゆる規模の企業がテクノロジーを活用して顧客、従業員、パートナーと連携を深めることができるようサポートしてください。

このチームはエンジニアやプロダクト マネージャー、セールス、マーケティングの各部門のプロフェッショナルで構成され、パートナーやお客様との連携を通じて、「世界中の情報を整理し、世界中の人々がアクセスして使えるようにする」という Google の使命を実現するために取り組んでいます。SAP セールス スペシャリストは、ソリューション ビジネス エグゼクティブとして、企業を対象としたダイレクト セールスに貢献するポジションです。主要なお客様と緊密に協力し、クラウド戦略の策定やデジタル変革をサポートすることが求められます。Google Cloud チームの一員として、Google Cloud Platform 上で SAP ワークロードを実行したいとお考えのお客様のサポートに努めるポジションです。Google プロダクトの革新性をわかりやすく伝え、お客様の生産性向上、コラボレーション、モバイル活用を支援していただきます。

Google Cloud Platform チームの使命は、クラウドに組み込まれたテクノロジーをあらゆることに活用して、お客様のビジネスの変革と進化に貢献することです。Google のプロダクトは、インフラストラクチャからアプリケーション、デバイス、ハードウェアまで多岐にわたりますが、いずれもセキュリティ、信頼性、拡張性を重視して開発されています。このチームでは、大小さまざまな企業、教育機関、政府機関、デベロッパーなどに、Google のテクノロジーがもたらすメリットを活用していただけるよう取り組んでいます。急成長するこの業界で、起業家精神あふれるチームの一員としてお客様のニーズを把握する重要な役割を果たし、あらゆる規模の企業がテクノロジーを活用して顧客、従業員、パートナーと連携を深められるようサポートしてください。

テクニカル セールス コンサルタントは、セールスチームと協力しながら、Google Cloud の差別化要因をお客様にアピールするポジションです。既存のお客様や見込み顧客に Google Cloud の力を理解していただいてください。また、お客様やパートナーのビジネス課題を解決できるクリエイティブなクラウド ソリューションやアーキテクチャの開発、概念実証のほか、技術的な質問への対応や障害のトラブルシューティングも担当してください。専門知識とプレゼンテーション能力を活かした対話の中でお客様のビジネス要件と技術的要件を理解し、そのうえで Google Cloud を活用した実践的で有益なソリューションを説得力を持って提案してください。

メンバーが互いに尊重し合い、チャンスが平等に与えられる環境で、Google チームの一員として存分に活躍してください。

Google Cloud は、あらゆる組織のビジネスと業界におけるデジタル トランスフォーメーションを加速させるとともに、Google の最先端テクノロジーを活用したエンタープライズ グレードのソリューションと、デベロッパーがよりサステナブルに構築に取り組めるツールを提供します。200 以上の国や地域のお客様が、成長を可能にし、最も重大なビジネス上の問題を解決するための信頼できるパートナーとして、Google Cloud を採用しています。

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

リバース オペレーション チームは、Google ハードウェアの販売後の修理とサプライ チェーン ネットワークのエンドツーエンドの管理を担当しています。グローバル ベンダーや部門横断型のチームと連携して、優れた修理サービスを提供し、スペア部品のサプライ チェーンを最適化し、リバース ロジスティクスの機能を拡大します。

この職種は、Google Pixel やその他の Google デバイスのカスタマー エクスペリエンスに直接影響を与えます。急速に成長しているハードウェア エコシステムにおいて、効率性を高め、地域戦略をリードし、オペレーショナル エクセレンスを確保する重要な役割を担っていただきます。

Google の使命は、世界中の情報を体系化して時間や場所を選ばずアクセスできるようにし、あらゆる人々の利便性を高めることです。Google のデバイス＆サービス チームは、Google の優れた AI、ソフトウェア、ハードウェアを組み合わせて、ユーザーの皆様がいつでも必要なときに利用できる便利なプロダクトの開発に取り組んでいます。ユーザーの皆様に、より高速でシームレス、かつ強力なコンピューティング処理をお届けするために、新しい技術やハードウェアの調査、設計、開発を行うことが職務です。また、世の中を知るための新しい手段を探求する、フォーム ファクタを進化させる、操作性を改善するなど、テクノロジーによって人々の生活をより良いものにすることを目指しています。

Responsibilities

  • 日本デポにおけるポストセールスの修理業務とリバース ロジスティクス プログラムの計画、および日々の運用を主導する。
  • サードパーティのサービス プロバイダや主な通信事業者パートナーとの戦略的関係を管理し、運用 SLA とビジネス要件の遵守を徹底する。
  • 継続的な改善のイニシアチブを推進して修理業務を最適化し、Google Pixel やその他の Google ハードウェア デバイスの修理に関するカスタマー エクスペリエンスの質を高める。
  • 国内外における部門横断型チームと連携し、新製品の導入（NPI）を支援する。
  • 運用指標とシステム上の問題を分析して根本原因を見極め、効果的かつスケーラブルなソリューションのエスカレーションおよび実装を進める。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • ビジネス、サプライ チェーン、エンジニアリングのいずれかの分野で学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • プログラムまたはプロジェクトの管理に携わった 5 年以上の経験。
  • 日本語と英語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、国内の通信事業者や修理パートナーと協力し、グローバル チームと連携して業務を遂行できること。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • コンシューマー ハードウェア業界で、リバース ロジスティクス、サプライ チェーン オペレーション、アフターセールス サービスのいずれかの業務に携わった 8 年以上の経験。
  • 新製品の導入（NPI）、システム統合、継続的な改善の取り組みなど、部門横断型のプロジェクトを管理した経験。
  • サードパーティ サービス プロバイダ（3P）、ベンダー、または通信事業者との戦略的関係を管理した経験。
  • 優れた分析力と問題解決能力、および複雑な運用指標を分析して根本原因を見極め、スケーラブルなソリューションを実装することができる能力。

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

We are building Intuitive, and effective searching and finding experiences by enabling search journeys that bridge across Google Workspace products (e.g., Gmail, Chat, Drive, etc.). We have an ambitious roadmap for making Workspace Search excellent, including the usage of advanced Machine Learning (ML) technologies, significant user-facing changes, revamping our evaluation framework and more.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of end-to-end search solutions, from understanding natural language queries to developing and deploying machine learning models that significantly improve search quality.
  • Drive innovation by exploring and integrating machine learning techniques, algorithms, and architectures to enhance search relevance and user experience.
  • Own the technical goal and roadmap for critical areas of Workspace Search, collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and deliver on a strategic roadmap.
  • Establish and refine evaluation frameworks and metrics to measure and track progress against key performance-indicators.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software engineering with Information Retrieval (IR), Natural Language Processing (NLP) or Machine Learning (ML).
  • Experience with launching user-facing, large-scale, production quality systems.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing large-scale, high-performance, distributed search or quality systems in production environments.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with embedding-based retrieval, vector search, query understanding or Large Language Models (LLMs) applied to search/recommendation systems.
  • Experience mamaging system latency improvements (e.g., progressive loading, perfecting techniques, or bypassing post-retrieval latency overhead) and scalability enhancements.
  • Background in defining metrics, analyzing user-perception surveys, and running complex search experiments.
  • Good understanding of agentic architectures, tool-calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounding layers.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability todrive technical alignment with cross-functional stakeholders and navigate competing priorities.

In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

As a Power Design Manager within Google's silicon team, you will help deliver solutions that have a substantive impact on the technical infrastructure that enables Google. You will provide technical leadership to a group of power design engineers in an innovative and fast-paced environment, with a focus on ASIC power architecture, design and project execution. You will own and drive complex technical projects from the concept/planning stage through execution and closure. You will bring out the best in your team to deliver designs that work for the first time with optimal power. You will bring your knowledge and experience in large SoC power architecture and design, ability to work with IP and chip vendors and manufacturers, and ability to work across organizational boundaries to identify the right people to provide technical input and execution to deliver SoC-centric products that are key to Google's computing infrastructure.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a power design team responsible for power architecture, power optimization and system power integration.
  • Lead an experienced team, define the processes, methods and tools to continuously improve the power efficiency of the TPU designs.
  • Contribute to design power modeling and drive convergence to power targets.
  • Investigate, specify, and deploy architectural and microarchitectural power optimization techniques, defining best practices and methodologies to achieve low-power RTL designs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional software and system teams to create novel power management architectures to meet power goals.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with ASIC or SoC design.
  • Experience with power design, power modeling, power architecture, or power reduction methodologies/techniques.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • 5 years of experience managing mid-sized ASIC/SOC design teams with focus on power design and optimization.
  • Experience defining and implementing chip-wide power management architectures and designs.
  • Experience in power modeling, measurement, and correlation across the pre- and post-silicon phases.
  • Understanding of modern power and thermal management techniques at both the silicon and system levels (including Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), Turboing, Thermal Management, and System-Level Tradeoffs).
  • Ability to solve open-ended power and performance problems under ambiguity.

You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The team supports new product introductions into the fleet.

We are transitioning from static traditional tools to active, multi-agent AI workflows. These agents will autonomously diagnose equipment anomalies, optimize liquid and traditional cooling loops in real-time, orchestrate server swap-out logistics, and automate complex incident resolution paths across our physical and digital fleet.

As the AI Agents Development Technical Program Manager, you will lead the end-to-end execution, delivery, and scaling of autonomous, decision-making AI systems designed to optimize global data center operations.

In this high-impact, cross-functional role, you will sit at the intersection of physical infrastructure and software engineering. You will partner closely with software developers, systems architects, site operations leads, and hardware engineering teams to build robust, reliable, and production-grade operational software.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Google の決済プラットフォームは、Google のプロダクト（AdWords、Play、Cloud、YouTube、gStore など）全体で数十億件の取引を処理しています。Payments パートナーシップ チームは、戦略的な関係を構築し、すべての Google ユーザーに信頼性と費用対効果に優れた安全なコマース体験を提供します。

ストラテジック パートナー マネージャーは、部門横断型チーム（ファイナンス、法務など）と連携して、決済エコシステムの主要なプレーヤーとのパートナーシップを構築、管理し、すべての Google プロダクトとサービスにおける決済取引の処理をサポートするポジションです。

こうしたパートナーシップの管理を担い、Google の代表としてビジネス、業界、規制当局のリーダーと連携しながら Google の決済処理を最適化し、シームレスなユーザー エクスペリエンスを確保するとともに、コンプライアンスの持続可能性、スケーラビリティのイノベーション、業界全体の効率化を推進していただきます。

グローバル パートナーシップ部門は、Google パートナーとの新たなビジネス チャンスを発掘する部門です。Google のグローバル パートナーシップ チームは、多様なパートナーと連携して、各パートナーが Google プロダクトのメリットを最大限に活かせるよう支援します。また、このチームは Google のプロダクト チームもサポートしています。プロダクト チームとのパートナーシップは、Google プロダクト（広告、検索、アシスタント、マップ、Travel、ショッピング、Payments など）のユーザー エクスペリエンス向上に欠かせない要素です。他にも、サービスを提供するためのパートナーシップの構築、市場開拓戦略の策定、ビジネス拡大の促進を担当し、さまざまなプロダクトに携わっています。

Responsibilities

  • 日本と韓国の市場特有の決済慣行、潜在的なパートナー、業界規制、コンプライアンス要件に関して、Google のプロダクト チームに指針を示す。
  • パートナーシップ開発のライフサイクル全体の管理を担い、RFI（情報提供依頼書）や RFP（提案依頼書）のプロセス主導や契約交渉、さらには支払い方法、決済サービス プロバイダ（PSP）、銀行、ネットワーク パートナーシップといったパートナーとの継続的な関係構築・維持をリードする。
  • パートナーのスコアカードや指標、評価の分析を通じて継続的な改善を主導するとともに、取引処理コストの最適化と削減を図り、収益性を向上させる。
  • Google の代表として、パートナー、ネットワーク、イシュア、アクワイヤラ、規制当局との戦略的な交渉の場に臨み、処理能力、コンプライアンス、市場のサステナビリティのさらなる強化を図る。
  • 日本と韓国の決済エコシステムを俯瞰し、業界全体の改善点を特定するとともに、その実現に向けた働きかけを行う。Google のプロダクト ロードマップや台頭するトレンドに方向性を合わせ、パートナー戦略を形作る。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • 学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • ビジネス開発、パートナーシップ業務、経営コンサルティング、投資銀行業務のいずれかに携わった 10 年以上の経験。
  • 経営幹部や、あらゆるレベルの管理職と部門を横断して連携し、業務を遂行した経験。
  • 英語と日本語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、この職種で求められる顧客対応をスムーズに行い、国内外のお客様やステークホルダーとやり取りできること。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • 修士号など大学院レベルの学位。
  • 日本または韓国の決済業界でパートナーシップを構築、管理し、10 年以上にわたって成果を上げた経験。
  • プロセッサ、イシュア、アクワイアラ、ネットワーク、規制当局との直接交渉またはエンゲージメントを通じて、決済処理または補助サービス契約を確保した経験。
  • 日本または韓国における決済処理の規制、運用ルール、標準契約条件に関する深い知識。
  • 英語、日本語、韓国語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、担当地域のパートナーやステークホルダーと効果的に関係を構築できること。

You will provide technical direction, architect solutions, and make contributions across multiple domains and markets (e.g., eWallets, A2A rails, conversion funnels).   • Advocate for AI-accelerated development workflows by defining team-wide policies for the verification, security, and maintenance of AI-generated code.

  • 6 years of experience with software architecture, driving technical consensus among globally distributed stakeholders.

ビジネス上のニーズやパートナーのニーズと技術的な制約との間のバランスを取り、革新的な最先端ソリューションを開発するだけでなく、お客様やチームにとってのパートナーかつコンサルタントとなることが期待されます。さらに、ツールの構築やプロダクトの自動化、Google のパートナーシップの技術運用と事業運営の統括に加え、プロダクト戦略の立案、プロジェクトやリソースの優先順位決定まで行える能力が求められます。

  • 見込み顧客やパートナーに Google Cloud の価値を伝え、理解を促進する。Google Cloud の技術的特徴を説明し、お客様のアーキテクチャ設計を支援するほか、潜在的な問題を積極的に解決する。

必要な条件/経験:

  • 会話型 AI テクノロジーに携わった 2 年以上の経験。
  • AI ソリューションまたは ML API の構築や活用、AI 手法やフレームワークを利用したアプリケーションの開発の経験。
  • 技術関係者や経営幹部に対応し、プレゼンテーションを行った経験。
  • 日本語と英語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、社内外の関係者とスムーズに連絡を取り合えること。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • コンタクト センターのテクノロジーとプラットフォームに携わり、会話型アプリケーションを構築した経験。
  • AI（ML API、ML テンプレート、RAG、LLM など）を構築、使用した経験。
  • Java、C++、Python のいずれかを使用してコーディングを行った経験。
  • ドキュメントと画像 AI に携わった経験。

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to the customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, present solutions on Google Cloud.

You will identify, pursue, and win new business workloads and drive engagement within existing ones. You will have technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand key customer technical objections, and develop a strategy to resolve technical blockers.
  • Provide enterprise infrastructure/cloud modernization expertise to support the technical relationship with Google’s customers, including product and solution briefings, proof-of-concept work, and partnering directly with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer adoption to Google Cloud.
  • Guide customers through assessments of their existing legacy application environments, provide recommendations on a prioritization road map for application modernization, and identify applications for migration to hybrid-cloud computing models.
  • Structure and execute prototyping workshops to prove out proposed architectures, developing best practices, and documenting key blocking requirements for prioritization with engineering.
  • Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in container-based application development, relevant to integration/deployment, developer operations, infrastructure as code, and architecting with cloud native technology.
  • 2 years of experience developing CI/CD pipelines and integrating them with Kubernetes.
  • 2 years of experience with developing, scaling, and managing Kubernetes clusters.
  • Ability to communicate in Japanese and English fluently to interact with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or other technical fields.
  • 2 years of experience as a lead architect/engineer to develop system architecture with cloud native technologies for medium to large systems.
  • Experience as a technology consultant, technical architect, enterprise architect, technical sales engineer, or solutions architect.
  • Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go, etc.).
  • Excellent business level communication skills.

Google では、ユーザーを第一に考えています。常に変化し続ける世界の中でプロダクト マネージャーに求められるのは、変化に敏感に対応し、億単位のユーザーが日常的に触れるプロダクトの開発に熱意を持って取り組むことです。

プロダクト マネージャーは、さまざまなチームと連携し、テクノロジーとビジネスの世界を結び付け、プロダクトの構想からリリースまでを主導するポジションです。複雑な問題を具体的な処理手順に落とし込み、プロダクト開発を進められる人材が求められます。

Google が、世界を変える革新的なプロダクトをコンスタントに提供できる理由の一つは、プロダクト マネジメントにおける共同作業です。プロダクト マネジメント チームはクリエイティブなエンジニア、デザイナー、マーケティング担当者などと密接に協力して、世界中の情報へのアクセスを向上させるためのテクノロジーの設計と開発を支援しています。その使命は、Google ソリューションの分析、ポジショニング、パッケージング、プロモーション、カスタマイズに重点を置きながら、プロダクトの実行サイクル全体を主導することです。

Google マップと Google 検索ならではの大きな差別化要因として挙げられるのは、ユーザーによるレビューや地図の修正提案などのユーザー作成コンテンツ（UGC）です。これは、ユーザーが行き先を決めるうえで重要なだけでなく、マップを最新の状態に保つことにも大きな役割を果たしています。

リアルワールド エクスペリエンス（RWE）チームの使命は、世界中のユーザーが UGC を通じて現実世界での体験を共有し、その豊富な情報を自身の意思決定に活用できるようにすることです。日々投稿されるレビュー、評価、写真、動画、質問への回答は、Google 検索と Google マップのユーザーが行き先を決めるうえで役立っており、ひいては世界中のビジネスの進展にもつながっています。

RWE ガイド エディトリアル チームの使命は、ユーザーによる Google マップのレビューをより簡単で有益なものに進化させることです。これにより、他のユーザーは十分な情報に基づいて、行き先についての判断を下せるようになります。ジオチームは、マップ、Earth、ストリートビュー、Google Maps Platform などのプロダクトを通じて、Google ユーザーの皆様に正確かつ包括的で、利便性が高い地図を提供するために取り組んでいます。世界を広げ、日常生活に役立つ Google マップのサービスは、月間 10 億人を超えるユーザーによって日々利用されています。

また、さまざまなアプリやウェブサイトの強化に Google Maps Platform の機能を活用できるよう、デベロッパーの皆様を支援するのもジオチームの役割です。このチームは、複雑なコンピュータ サイエンスの問題解決、直感的に操作できる美しいプロダクト デザイン、実世界の把握精度の向上を通じて、地図の未来を切り拓きます。

Responsibilities

  • ガイド エディトリアル（レビュー機能）のプロダクト戦略を策定し、目標と戦略を UGC レビューの成長を後押しする具体的な優先度付きロードマップへと落とし込む。
  • データ、エンジニアリング、ユーザー エクスペリエンス（UX）、リサーチ、ポリシーまたは法務といった部門を横断するパートナー チームと緊密に連携し、合意形成を図る。
  • 現在の市場状況における機会を特定する。
  • UX、リサーチ、エンジニアリングの各チームと協力して、ユーザー作成コンテンツのレビュー投稿と利用の両方に対応する新しい機能を設計、リリースし、定着させる。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • 学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • プロダクト マネジメントに携わった 3 年以上の経験。
  • 技術的なプロダクトの構想からリリースまで携わった 1 年以上の経験（アイディエーションから実行まで、エンドツーエンド、0 から 1 の立ち上げなど）
  • 消費者向けプロダクトの開発経験。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • 技術またはビジネスに関連する分野の修士号。
  • さまざまな要素が複雑に関連する状況をシンプルなナラティブにまとめ、幹部向けのプレゼンテーションを行った経験
  • さまざまな部門（エンジニアリング、プロダクト、ユーザー エクスペリエンス（UX）、分析 / データ サイエンス、ポリシー、法務など）やチームと連携した経験。
  • 指標分析や実験分析（A/B テストなど）を行い、過去の分析情報に基づいて要点をまとめた経験
  • チームがより包括的な戦略を策定、実施できるよう、ビジネス上のトレードオフを定義し、定量化できること。
  • 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の適用領域に関する知識と、AIを活用した機能や体験の立ち上げ経験。

  • カスタマー エンジニアリング、マーケティング、カスタマー サクセス、プロダクト、エンジニアリング、チャネルなどの各チームと協力して市場参入戦略を策定し、パイプラインおよびビジネスの拡大を促進するとともに、契約を締結し、お客様のニーズを理解して、見込み顧客とお客様に優れたエクスペリエンスを提供する。
  • 複数のお客様に対応し、テクノロジー基盤、成長計画、ビジネスの推進要因、パフォーマー、Google のテクノロジーを使ってお客様のビジネスを変革する方法について理解する。
  • お客様の要件をビジネスと技術の両面から理解し、お客様とともにデータベース ソリューション ロードマップを策定する。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • 学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • エンタープライズ ソフトウェアまたはクラウド分野での 10 年以上のセールス経験。
  • データベース技術をお客様に販売した経験。
  • 日本語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、国内のステークホルダーと関係を構築できること。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • データと分析に沿って、ビジネス サイクル内の事業活動を計画して優先順位を付けた経験。
  • アカウント チーム、テクニカル リード、調達チーム、法務チームなど、社内外の各チームと協力して、既存のソフトウェア資産のリストアップ、変革に際してのケースと実装計画の作成、契約の締結を行った経験。
  • 経営幹部との関係をサポートし、新たな領域やアカウントを発掘しつつ、お客様にソリューションを導入して成功に導くことで、お客様の事業拡大につなげた経験。
  • 従来型の業界（製造、小売、消費財など）での実務経験。
  • クラウド、データベース、データのトレンド、プロダクト、ソリューションに関する知識（PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL データベース、Oracle、Spanner、Bigtable、Firestore、Memorystore など）。

変化の激しい今日のマーケティング環境において、あらゆる規模や業態のビジネスが、業界をリードする Google の広告ソリューションを活用し、成長を遂げています。本職種には、販売に対する情熱、オンライン メディアに関する知識に加え、お客様の成功の最大化に責任を持って取り組むことが求められます。常に主体的に行動し、変化を迅速に乗り越えながら、Google とお客様の両方で並外れた成果を継続的に生み出し、積み上げていくための革新的で戦略的な方法を策定する必要があります。信頼関係を築きつつ、お客様のビジネスニーズを見極め、ニーズに合致する優れたソリューションを導き出すことで、お客様が掲げる妥協のない目標の達成を目指します。セールス担当者と協力して目標を達成し、AI 時代における広告の未来を切り拓いて、Google を信頼して最も重要な目標を託してくださる何百万もの企業、何十億ものユーザーに真の価値をもたらすことができるよう取り組んでください。

グローバル クライアントを担当する第一広告営業本部（LCS）日本チームは、自動車やテクノロジーの分野で世界有数のブランドをサポートしています。マーケティングや広告の専門家で構成された専任チームは、各自のユニークなスキルを活かし、AI 時代における企業のグローバル規模でのビジネスの成長を支援します。チームの目標は、お客様のビジネス戦略にあらゆる側面からアドバイスを提供することであり、Google の広範なプロダクトを使用して、お客様が利用者の皆様とすばやくシームレスにつながり、持続性の高い成長を遂げられるようお手伝いします。

Responsibilities

  • グローバルなクライアントや代理店の主な連絡窓口として、B レベルおよび C レベル（経営幹部）との強固な関係を構築し、長期的なデジタル トランスフォーメーション戦略を推進する。
  • グローバル戦略を地域市場のニーズに合わせながら、Google のプロダクトとサービス全体にわたる包括的な共同ビジネスプラン（JBP）の策定を支援する。
  • 複数の Google チーム（LCS、Google Cloud、YouTube）が関与するプロジェクトを主導し、協力してクライアントへの影響を最大化するとともに、プロダクト ソリューションを最適化する。
  • お客様のビジネスと業界、広告業界に関する深い知識を活用して成長の機会を見出し、プライバシーに関する規則など、将来の課題に対処する。
  • シニア リーダーと関係を構築して信頼を高め、戦略的な連携を推進するとともに、Google とパートナー様のチーム間のコラボレーションを促進して、共通の目標を達成する。

Qualifications

必要な条件/経験:

  • 学士号を取得していること（同等の実務経験でも可）。
  • 広告セールス、マーケティング、コンサルティング、メディアでの実務、または広告代理店との協業における 11 年以上の経験。
  • 英語と日本語による優れたコミュニケーション能力を備え、この職種で求められる顧客対応をスムーズに行い、国内外のお客様やステークホルダーとやり取りできること。

望ましい経験/スキル:

  • 経営幹部を対象としたプレゼンテーションの実施、および事業開発、セールス リーダーシップ、戦略的パートナーシップを推進した経験。
  • 複雑なデータを分析し、高成長をもたらすコマーシャル戦略を構築、実行、拡大した実績。
  • ゲーム / エンターテイメント、検索、YouTube に関する知識があり、プライバシー規則をめぐり高度な対話を主導できること。
  • 複数のクライアント アカウントとクロスファンクショナルなワークストリームを管理、整理、優先順位付けできること。
  • 進化するマーケットプレイスのニーズに積極的に対応しながら、Google の持続性の高い広告ソリューションを推進できること。

The RES - MoW team, manages the end-to-end lifecycle of Google’s Core and Non-Core real estate holdings across the Americas, EMEA, APAC, and India .

In this role, your primary goal is to provide cost-effective and flexible real estate solutions to Google and Alphabet. They execute a full range of real estate strategies including acquisitions, dispositions, leasing, development, transactions, and property management to optimize portfolio performance and create value.

The team partners with regional leaders to develop and deliver customized supply-side strategies. They act with agility and speed to ensure Google’s real estate portfolio is effectively optimized, aligning with business objectives, financial targets, and long-term goal.

The RES - MoW team functions as an integral pillar within the broader Global Real Estate (GRE) organization. Their work ensures seamless integration of GRE actions with strategic portfolio plans and Non-Core exit strategies. The GRE organization's overarching function is to coordinate these supply-side strategies and execute real estate solutions across the company’s global operations.

Responsibilities

  • Execute regional real estate transactions across India covering Office/Commercial, Land, Industrial, Retail and other real estate asset classes, optimising portfolio performance, risk mitigation, resilience, and total cost efficiency.
  • Capitalise on market opportunities to deliver proactive, agile real estate solutions aligned with business growth and partner requirements.
  • Negotiating and delivering to the execution plans of complex real estate transactions (build, buy, lease) at high volume and scale.
  • Mobilise cross-functional teams across REWS, Legal, Finance, Tax, and Compliance to deliver real estate transactions on schedule. Maintain operational accountability for space delivery, integrating seamlessly with local leadership and key business stakeholders.
  • Enforce financial discipline across transactions, structuring contracts to maximise commercial value and minimise long-term legal liabilities. Manage partners such as brokers /transaction teams to support timely and compliant transaction delivery.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in real estate transactions (e.g., leasing, purchasing, build-to-suit, and development), transactions across multiple countries, real estate planning, finance and financial modeling, and corporate strategy.
  • Experience in legal document review and commercial negotiation in conjunction with legal counsel.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Management and a related Real Estate field.
  • Recognised professional qualifications in real estate related areas such as MCR/ MRICS.
  • Experience in delivering key real estate business transactions, developing and evolving new concepts to solve for a fast moving and continuously changing real estate business environment.
  • Demonstrate ethics that motivates and inspires them to deliver to the set challenges and to be successful.
  • Ability to manage across a regional base both direct and indirect team members to deliver a real estate business plan.

As a member of Google’s global Transportation Team, you will play a key role in Google’s growth. You will be part of the team overseeing one of the largest global corporate transportation programs, ensuring excellence in service delivery. Our direction is to contribute to the productivity of Google’s evolving workplace with sustainable and innovative mobility options. Our mission is to plan, implement, and operate cost effective mobility solutions to support Google’s global portfolio.

You will be responsible for service delivery of transportation services in Google’s India, as well as other locations in APAC and EMEA. You will be an integral part of the global Transportation Team, managing and collaborating in a partnership mode with key vendor partners. Through these partnerships you will be responsible for improving the commute transport experience that enables Google to grow. Your responsibilities in this position include tracking progress toward program goals and strategies, overseeing financial management, supervising daily transport operations, managing program and operational governance, and directing project schedules. You will report progress providing regular program updates to management on impact and issues. You will design, implement and manage Google's Transport service offerings. You are an exceptional communicator, adept at navigating projects alongside a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee Bangalore’s transportation programs and initiatives, including additional operational support across India-based locations. Ensure uniform and efficient service delivery by upholding strategic direction, managing financial operations, and maintaining vendor partnerships.
  • Transform the commuter journey into a seamless, high-reliability experience that enhances employee productivity and reinforces Google’s high employee experience standards.
  • Manage a complex portfolio of transport providers, moving beyond basic oversight to Partnership Management that drives innovation and service resilience.
  • Oversee transport operations with a high degree of focus, ensuring exceptional employee satisfaction, and leveraging data-driven insights with real-time feedback to sustain industry-leading sentiment scores.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the various real estate and workplace services teams including workplace services, Security, transactions, and project executive teams. Support other program operations as necessary throughout other locations in APAC and EMEA.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience in corporate employee transportation operations and services.
  • Experience with developing and managing budgets and capital budget justification.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in vendor and program management.
  • Experience in safety and risk management.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive incidents and crises, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team.

As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and integrate safety solutions based on risk assessments to maximize worker protection in R&D, lab settings and office environments.
  • Oversee the creation of procedures, program documentation, and digital tracking systems to ensure safety solutions scale across the region. 
  • Partner with cross-functional teams such as security and facilities to embed safety protocols into daily operations.
  • Conduct regular audits and risk assessments; draft high-level reports for leadership on site safety and health.
  • Lead incident investigations, incident response and tactical exercises. Support all campus compliance with local, national, and state environment, health, and safety (EHS) regulations along with company standards.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in environment, health and safety (EHS).

Preferred qualifications:

  • EHS related licenses, or certifications (Certified Industrial Hygienist, Certified Safety Professional, Certified Hazardous Materials Manager, or similar).
  • Experience managing campus operations with a focus on compliance, research labs, permitting, employee safety, and emergency management.
  • Experience working in a cross functional team environment in close partnership with facility management teams, security, and business leadership.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, concurrent projects in a fast-paced, evolving environment; strong analytical and technical skills including the use of AI tools.

Một vấn đề chỉ thực sự được giải quyết khi không còn ai gặp vướng mắc. Đó là lý do nhân viên của Google xây dựng những sản phẩm tạo ra cơ hội cho mọi người, bất kể là họ sinh sống tại địa phương hay trên khắp thế giới. Trong vai trò Quản lý chương trình kỹ thuật tại Google, bạn sẽ vận dụng chuyên môn kỹ thuật của mình để dẫn dắt từ đầu đến cuối các dự án phức tạp và đa lĩnh vực. Bạn sẽ làm việc với các bên liên quan để dự trù yêu cầu, phát hiện rủi ro, quản lý lịch biểu dự án và trao đổi rõ ràng với các đối tác liên chức năng trong công ty. Bạn tự tin giải thích các điểm phân tích và đề xuất của nhóm với ban lãnh đạo, cũng như thảo luận với các kỹ sư về những phương án đánh đổi về mặt kỹ thuật trong quá trình phát triển sản phẩm.

Sứ mệnh của Google là hệ thống hoá thông tin của thế giới và giúp thông tin đó trở nên hữu ích và dễ tiếp cận trên toàn cầu. Nhóm Thiết bị và Dịch vụ của chúng tôi kết hợp những điểm ưu việt nhất trong công nghệ AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google, nhằm mang lại trải nghiệm hữu ích vượt trội cho người dùng. Chúng tôi nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ cùng phần cứng mới để người dùng có thể tương tác với công nghệ điện toán một cách nhanh chóng, mạnh mẽ và liền mạch hơn. Nhóm Thiết bị và Dịch vụ đang làm cho cuộc sống của mọi người trở nên tốt đẹp hơn thông qua công nghệ, bất kể bằng việc tìm kiếm cách mới để nắm bắt và cảm nhận thế giới xung quanh, cải tiến kiểu dáng sản phẩm hay nâng cấp phương thức tương tác.

Responsibilities

  • Quản lý các trạm kiểm thử tại nhà máy từ giai đoạn lên ý tưởng đến giai đoạn duy trì, đóng vai trò là đầu mối liên hệ cho các nhóm nội bộ và bên ngoài (CM/nhà cung cấp thiết bị cố định), quản lý khả năng sẵn sàng kiểm thử tổng thể (xVT đến MP), rủi ro và giao tiếp với các phòng ban liên ngành.

  • Vạch ra chiến lược kiểm thử và tối ưu hoá các quy trình kiểm thử trên toàn bộ dây chuyền sản xuất từ SMT, cụm lắp ráp con cho đến quy trình FATP (Lắp ráp, kiểm thử và đóng gói hoàn thiện).

  • Thúc đẩy CPK, giảm tỷ lệ kiểm thử lại và giải quyết vấn đề khi kiểm thử trong các giai đoạn sản xuất.

  • Làm việc với CM về SOP liên quan đến kiểm thử, mức độ sẵn sàng của thiết bị cố định cho việc kiểm thử, thời gian của chu trình sản xuất/UPH và cân bằng dây chuyền sản xuất. Quản lý lịch biểu và lập kế hoạch cho tất cả các sản phẩm bàn giao thuộc phạm vi kỹ thuật kiểm thử (các tính năng/giải pháp thu thập dữ liệu, cập nhật phần mềm khung kiểm thử, đưa thiết bị cố định vào hoạt động, phê duyệt chất lượng thiết bị cố định, kiểm định thường xuyên, v.v.).

  • Hợp tác với các nhà cung cấp và các nhóm kỹ sư trong việc xây dựng phạm vi kiểm thử, bao gồm cả bước đánh giá lưu đồ quy trình, thiết kế thiết bị/thiết bị cố định, cơ chế kiểm soát quy trình, lịch trình triển khai và kế hoạch thẩm định trước khi có bản dựng xVT. 

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân ngành Kỹ thuật điện, Khoa học máy tính hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý chương trình.
  • Kinh nghiệm về kỹ thuật kiểm thử trong sản xuất, bao gồm cả DFM cho thiết bị cố định, tự động hoá kiểm thử và tối ưu hoá phạm vi kiểm thử.
  • Kinh nghiệm về NPI cho thiết bị điện tử tiêu dùng (ví dụ: điện thoại thông minh, máy tính xách tay, thiết bị đeo), cụ thể là phát triển chiến lược kiểm thử Công nghệ dán bề mặt (SMT) và Lắp ráp, kiểm thử và đóng gói hoàn thiện (FATP), cũng như thúc đẩy các chỉ số chất lượng và Chỉ số năng lực quy trình (Cpk).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 12 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực kiểm thử sản xuất và quản lý chương trình.
  • Có 5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên chức năng hoặc liên phòng ban.
  • Kinh nghiệm gỡ lỗi trong quá trình kiểm thử phần cứng, khắc phục sự cố, tối ưu hoá Chi phí tài sản cố định (Capex) và điều tra phân tích lỗi.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý các phòng ban liên ngành và làm việc với các đối tác là nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM) quốc tế để sản xuất hàng loạt các sản phẩm điện tử tiêu dùng.
  • Khả năng nói tiếng Anh và tiếng Trung lưu loát để liên hệ với các đối tác.
  • Có thể đi công tác lên đến 30% thời gian làm việc (nếu cần).

responsibilities: Quản lý các trạm kiểm thử tại nhà máy từ giai đoạn lên ý tưởng đến giai đoạn duy trì, đóng vai trò là đầu mối liên hệ cho các nhóm nội bộ và bên ngoài (CM/nhà cung cấp thiết bị cố định), quản lý khả năng sẵn sàng kiểm thử tổng thể (xVT đến MP), rủi ro và giao tiếp với các phòng ban liên ngành.
Vạch ra chiến lược kiểm thử và tối ưu hoá các quy trình kiểm thử trên toàn bộ dây chuyền sản xuất từ SMT, cụm lắp ráp con cho đến quy trình FATP (Lắp ráp, kiểm thử và đóng gói hoàn thiện).
Thúc đẩy CPK, giảm tỷ lệ kiểm thử lại và giải quyết vấn đề khi kiểm thử trong các giai đoạn sản xuất.

Làm việc với CM về SOP liên quan đến kiểm thử, mức độ sẵn sàng của thiết bị cố định cho việc kiểm thử, thời gian của chu trình sản xuất/UPH và cân bằng dây chuyền sản xuất. Our mission is to seamlessly connect people, products, and AI experiences so more users unlock the full value of Google, which means getting the best of both individual first-party (1P) products—via the most relevant features and content—and the ecosystem through connected, helpful cross-product experiences. The Ecosystem Group (EG) drives this mission across three pillars: Ecosystem Experiences, focusing on user-facing growth touchpoints and cross-app journeys; the Notifications Platform (Google and Notifications Team, GaNT), managing Google’s centralized notification and communication infrastructure (Google Notifications Platform, GNP) across core products including Google Search, YouTube, Google Chrome, and Gemini; and the People Platform, delivering the foundational social graph, identity, and connectivity infrastructure across Google. The People Platform team powers all people-centric interactions by developing and maintaining the central People Graph, robust contact management solutions, insightful analytics, and essential sharing infrastructure, leveraging AI to enable first-party products to build rich, deeply personalized user experiences rooted in a consistent understanding of personal relationships and context.

In this role, you will lead and guide a team of data scientists delivering quantitative analysis to improve user experience quality across the ecosystem, supporting decisions that drive deeper engagement and meaningful user outcomes.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a group of data scientists that is part of a broader data science organization in Core Experience that aims to provide analysis capabilities to the Ecosystem Growth team.
  • Work with cross-functional partners, primarily within the People Platform pillar of the broader Growth, Identity, and Ecosystems (GI&E) organization, to understand opportunities to improve the connection, sharing, and identity experience for Google users.
  • Support our team in carrying out analysis to support the People Platform organization in identifying the best opportunities for improving user journeys across products in the Google ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and data engineers to improve and mature the broader organization's capacity to quickly make quality, data-driven decisions.
  • Serve as leader for a group of data scientists, providing both technical direction and managerial guidance.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 8 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 6 years of work experience with a PhD degree.
  • 3 years of experience as a people manager within a technical leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD degree in statistics or other advanced quantitative degree with significant relevant statistics experience.
  • 10 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 8 years of work experience with a PhD degree.
  • Experience in working with personalization and cross product.
  • Experiences with driving product growth and engagement.
